stemMd: Every parcel in shelf A is insured. Every insured parcel is tracked. Which fact would contradict these rules?

options.label: A
options.textMd: A tracked parcel is not insured.

options.label: B
options.textMd: An insured parcel is on shelf B.

options.label: C
options.textMd: A tracked parcel is on shelf A.

options.label: E
options.textMd: An untracked parcel is on shelf A.

explanationMd: Shelf A implies insured and insured implies tracked. A parcel on shelf A must therefore be tracked. An untracked one there would violate the chain, while the converse relationships are not required.

distractorRationale.b: The rules do not restrict all insured parcels to shelf A.
distractorRationale.d: Universal implications can hold when there are no parcels on the shelf.
distractorRationale.c: That is consistent with the implication chain.
